scope_of_work.details: Work executed on turnkey basis including survey, network design, supply, manufacturer's quality assurance, testing, transportation, storage, erection, including all civil/structural works, site testing, commissioning of all items & materials and all associated activities for completion and satisfactory performance of entire works

Providing engineering data and drawings for review, approval and records. Supply, testing, packing, transportation and insurance from manufacturer's work to site. Receipt, storage, insurance, preservation and conservation of equipments at site
Design, engineering and construction of new primary substations with 33kV incoming lines and 11kV outgoing feeders. Includes all electrical equipment, civil works, testing and commissioning
New distribution transformer substations with capacity 16 KVA to 315 KVA (single phase and three phase) installed on double pole structures. Includes survey, installation, testing and commissioning
New 33 kV lines, 22 kV lines, and 11 kV lines including survey, design, erection of poles, stringing of conductors, and commissioning
HVDS system for remote locations, theft prone areas, and dedicated agricultural connections. Includes 11 kV lines with distribution transformers of 10-25 KVA capacity
HT/LT underground cabling works including laying, jointing, testing and commissioning of underground cables
Low tension distribution lines for consumer connections including poles, conductors, and associated hardware
Augmentation of existing power transformers and substations, renovation works of existing infrastructure
Design, engineering and construction of all civil works at power substations, line foundations, DTR substations including soil investigation. All works as per Indian Laws, Standards and Codes

GIS tagging of all new assets using mobile app. Engraving 'Developed under MPDEP (ADB) Scheme' on materials. Installation of signboards for major infrastructure showing work details, commissioning date, cost, and scheme information
Preparation of project completion report/closure proposal with clear indication of completion of outstanding/remedial work. Warranty period services and activities as per contract
